rows.en:
I went into the classroom.
Desks and chairs stood in neat rows.
Seeing it like this, it's hard to believe students use it during the day.
The classroom feels colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I have to search.
First, I check the teacher's platform.
...Nothing.
Next, I check the desks.
Of course, I search thoroughly inside them too.
...Nothing.
I search every corner of the room.
It doesn't look like it's in this classroom.{p}

I went into the classroom.
Rows of desks and chairs, neatly lined up.
Seeing it like this, it was hard to believe students used it during the day.
The classroom felt colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I had to search.
First, I checked the teacher's lectern.
There seemed to be something inside it.
What could it be?
I shoved my hand in.
Ow☆
I yanked it back out.
When I looked closely, I saw the inside of the lectern was covered solid with thumbtacks.
Was this the work of Hino and the others?
Had they known I would shove my hand in here?
...No, that couldn't be.
It was just a coincidence.
It had to be.
There didn't seem to be anything else in this classroom.{p}
Which floor's restroom should I go to?
Should I search the boys' restroom or the girls' restroom?

The girls' restroom had four stalls.
I felt a little guilty going in, but this was no time to worry about that.{p}Where should I search?

I'd try this one.
I searched every inch of the stall.
...Nothing.
No good.
I'd have to search somewhere else.{p}
The boys' restroom had four urinals and two toilet stalls.{p}Where should I search?

I looked over the row of four urinals.
...Nothing seemed out of the ordinary.{p}Where should I search?

I decided to search the toilet stall.
...Surely it wouldn't be inside the toilet bowl itself, would it?

...Nothing.{p}
